name: Tinoco & Ortiz 2014: independent 8-coil 'God Helmet' rebuild, 100 Hz figure-eight (20 min)
origin: Carlos A. Tinoco & Joao P. L. Ortiz, Integrated Center for Experimental Research, Curitiba, Brazil: helmet built and sessions run outside Persinger's lab; word-scoring analysis with contributions from C. Whissell
summary: A rebuild of the God Helmet by a group that made its own hardware: 100 Hz pulses for 20 min, one left-right coil pair at a time, stepping every 250 ms in a figure-eight over four coils per temporal lobe. The paper reports that field and sham groups differed only in the wording of their reports after the session, not in what they said during it.
notes: Tinoco & Ortiz built their own helmet (Tinoco & Ortiz 2014 p.1 [234]) and, lacking Persinger's files, used 'simple' 100 Hz pulses (p.6-7 [239-240]). One pair of coils was active at a time, changing every 250 ms: posterior to anterior superior temporal lobe, then posterior to anterior inferior, 'not unlike a figure eight' (p.7 [240]); 20 min. This program plays 5 ms on and 5 ms off in one polarity; the duty cycle is an assumption. The circuit drawings show one oscillator and one counter, no second timing source, so 100 Hz pulses stepped every 250 ms cannot be derived from them (p.21-22 [254-255]); the program follows the text. No electrode positions are given: TP7h, T7h, TP9h, T9h and their mirrors are this project's reading. Field: three statements five orders of magnitude apart, none measured as a field, none with a place: '0.0001 Tesla (10 mG)' (p.1 [234]), calculated 'RMS peaks of 0.000001 Tesla (10 mG)' (p.6 [239]) and 0.001 uT from a current reading (p.5 [238]). 1 uT is used. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. Support: one study. What subjects said during the session did not differ between field and sham; only the wording afterwards did. Group sizes are inconsistent: 10 + 10 (Table 2, p.15 [248]), '40% of the participants' for the field group (p.13 [246]), '20 volunteers who received magnetic stimulation' in the abstract. Controls had the helmet 'left off' (p.7 [240]); the paper does not say whether the questioner was blind. Reports were scored with Whissell's Dictionary of Affect in Language (p.8 [241]); the paper thanks Dr. Cynthia Whissel for help with the analysis (p.18 [251]). Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop on distress.
setting: Seated in a comfortable chair with a blindfold, told only that it is a 'God Helmet' session. In the last 2 minutes, ask about sights, sounds, touch, smells, tastes and emotions, and record the answers for blind scoring.
schedule: One 20-min session per person; the originals ran in the afternoon (14:00-18:00) on three days with a K index of 0-2.
source: Tinoco & Ortiz 2014, Magnetic stimulation of the temporal cortex: a partial 'God Helmet' replication study, J Conscious Explor Res 5(3):234-257 https://jcer.com/index.php/jcj/article/view/361 ; Wikipedia, God helmet (the only direct replication by a group unconnected to Persinger's lab) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/God_helmet ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/

phases.name: 100 Hz pulses, yoked pairs, figure-eight, 250 ms per coil
